description: This file defines the 'Details' feature within the 'Users' namespace, implementing functionality to retrieve user details based on username. It includes a query class, validator, and handler that queries the database for a user, handles not found cases, maps data to a user DTO, and generates a JWT token.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: Represents the query request with a username parameter, implementing IRequest to be handled by MediatR.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates that the username in the query is not null or empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the user detail query by fetching user data, handling not found cases, mapping to user DTO, and generating a token.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the query asynchronously, retrieves user data from the database, throws exception if not found, maps to user DTO, and generates a JWT token.
